title: Fake News (easy)
statementMd:
As it's the first of April, Heidi is suspecting that the news she reads today are fake, and she does not want to look silly in front of all the contestants. She knows that a newspiece is fake if it contains `heidi` as a subsequence. Help Heidi assess whether the given piece is true, but please be discreet about it...

## Input

The first and only line of input contains a single nonempty string $*s*$ of length at most $1000$ composed of lowercase letters (`a`-`z`).

## Output

Output `YES` if the string $*s*$ contains `heidi` as a subsequence and `NO` otherwise.

## Note

A string $*s*$ contains another string $*p*$ as a subsequence if it is possible to delete some characters from $*s*$ and obtain $*p*$.
statementZhMd:
由于今天是愚人节，Heidi 怀疑自己今天读到的新闻都是假的，她不想在所有参赛者面前出丑。她知道，如果一篇新闻报道中包含子序列 `heidi`，那么这篇报道就是假的。请帮助 Heidi 判断给定的报道是真是假，但请低调行事……

## 输入格式

输入仅包含一行，其中有一个非空字符串 $*s*$，长度至多为 $1000$，由小写字母（`a`-`z`）组成。

## 输出格式

如果字符串 $*s*$ 包含子序列 `heidi`，输出 `YES`；否则输出 `NO`。

## 说明

如果可以从字符串 $*s*$ 中删除一些字符得到字符串 $*p*$，那么称 $*s*$ 包含 $*p*$ 作为子序列。
